A drift of blue forget-me-nots pooling against a mossy boulder, their tiny faces turned toward the light filtering through the canopy above.
Tall foxglove spires in deep rose and pale cream rising from a ferny tangle, each thimble-bell speckled dark inside.
A low tumbled wall of lichen-silvered stones swallowed in cushion moss, barely knee-height, wandering crookedly across the foreground grass.
A skep beehive of golden woven straw sitting on a flat stone, a slow drift of bees circling in the warm air.
Wild herb tangles of silvery thyme and dark sage sprawling between the path stones, releasing a green bruised scent at every footfall.
A mossy stone birdbath cupped with rainwater, a single oak leaf floating on the still surface, the basin furred green to its rim.
A fairy ring of red-capped toadstools glowing faintly amber from within, the inner grass a deeper, darker green than the rest.
Blue lupine spires crowding the path edge in a dense tapestry of violet and periwinkle, their palmate leaves catching scattered dew.
A gate of living willow withies woven in an arching weave, new pale-green leaves budding along every curved stem.
A rope swing on a broad oak limb, the rope silver-grey with age, the wooden seat worn smooth and dark.
A cluster of white daisies with yolk-yellow hearts pressing cheerfully through a gap in the mossy wall, stems soft and bending.
A winding path of flat natural stones, every joint between them packed with bright moss, curving gently toward the shadowed doorstep.
A weathered wooden rowboat half-swallowed in tall reeds, its planks silvered and soft, a drift of forget-me-nots rooting in the bilge.
An ancient stone well mantled in ivy, the coping stones thick with moss, a wooden bucket resting on the worn ledge.
A stack of silvered split firewood stacked under the deep eave, pale lichens colonising the end-grain, a wren perched on the top round.
A scatter of butter-yellow primulas threading between root and stone along the path edge, their crinkled leaves dark and glossy.
Several red-capped toadstools clustering at the base of a gnarled root, their white gills just visible, one cap beaded with dew.
A small mossy hollow ringed with fern fronds where water pools black and still, reflecting a circle of pale sky.
Magenta campion in loose drifts spilling across the path, their notched petals bright against the grey-green of the surrounding moss.
Two straw skep beehives side by side on a mossy plank shelf, weathered to a soft tawny gold, drowsy with bee-hum.
A tangle of wild marjoram and woody thyme crowding a sunny stone, starred with tiny pale pink and mauve flowers.
White wood anemones carpeting a shaded patch of foreground ground, their slender stems trembling in the lightest movement of air.
A mossy stone wall crumbling at one end into a tumble of rounded stones, foxgloves rising tall from the rubble.
A woven willow fence running low along the path edge, moss beginning to green the older withies, new shoots curling free.
A ring of pale glowing toadstools circling a gnarled root in the foreground grass, the enclosed turf faintly luminous in the dusk.
